actual_scope: One fixed transported CRT exceptional-key implementation on five binary tapes: three current-state query epochs, literal modular shears, descriptor copies, full ROM scans, and exact tape-action events with cleanup.

This fixed implementation removes host whole-word arithmetic from one complete key invocation and exposes its actual descriptor/update/cleanup traffic; uniform parameter decoding, compiler setup, producer and repair composition remain open.
stop_rule: Stop after the two transported stale-offset discriminators, a bounded deterministic boundary set, source/receipt controls and independent event replay. Do not expand into a whole CRT repair, general parameter compiler or selected theorem audit.
evidence: 24 physical 18-bit key cases match the pinned literal caller at all three query epochs; nine behavior/ledger fault controls reject. Independent event replay validates all unit moves, reads and writes, borrowed tapes, scratch erasure and heads. Separate agent static and event review is AI evidence, not human/formal acceptance.
